name: lazarus.day
summary: Searches and reads lazarus.day (https://lazarus.day), the public DPRK indicator index by @lazarusholic (https://x.com/lazarusholic): keyword search stages matches as graph nodes, and exact-record lookup adds the reports naming them. Desktop only.
description:
For checking whether an indicator appears in public reporting on North Korean (DPRK) activity and which reports name it, or for finding indicators there by part of their value (not by report title or actor name).

**Needs:** nothing; the public pages are read anonymously.

**Cost:** none published; the site is one researcher's dataset, not an API, so requests are 350 ms apart.

**Who sees it:** only lazarus.day, which receives each keyword and indicator looked up. The indicators are never contacted.

**Read results with care:**
- lazarus.day flags its IoCs as auto-extracted and possibly benign: a hit means the value appears in DPRK reporting, not a verdict.
- No record is a real negative; a bot challenge or rate limit is reported as such, never as "no results".
- A report is a Campaign; its tags stay text and never become Threat Actor nodes.
- The site does not say which chain a wallet is on, so an address gets a network only when its format settles one (bc1…, ltc1…, T…, a CashAddr). A 0x address is on an unstated EVM chain; 1… or 3… stays unknown (Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash or SV).

**Data and licences:** the site's content and IoC data are © 2021–2026 @lazarusholic, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The pack is not affiliated with the site.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-lazarusday (Apache-2.0; the site captures in `test-fixtures/` and the thumbnail cropped from the site's artwork stay CC BY-SA 4.0, see `NOTICE`)

plugins.name: lazarus.day IoC Search
plugins.description: Searches lazarus.day’s public DPRK indicator index by keyword and adds each match as the node its category names — Domain, IP Address, URL, File Hash, E-mail Address, Crypto Address, ASN — carrying the record URL and first/last-seen dates. A Crypto Address gets the network its format settles, or is marked as not established. Matching is a case-insensitive substring of the indicator value. Desktop only.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword to search the indicator values for, e.g. "blockchain" or "kimsuky". The site matches a case-insensitive substring, so a domain, a hash prefix or a full value all work.

category.title: Category
category.description: Restrict the search to one IoC category. "all" searches every category. Default: all.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Result pages to read, 15 indicators each, newest first. One page is usually the right answer for a specific keyword; raise it for a broad one. Default: 1 (maximum 10).

network.purpose: Search lazarus.day’s public IoC index by keyword and read the result pages.

plugins.name: lazarus.day IoC Lookup
plugins.description: Looks up each selected Domain, IP Address, URL, File Hash, E-mail Address, Crypto Address or ASN as an exact record in lazarus.day’s public DPRK indicator index, writes the record’s dates and detail onto the node, adds each report that names it as a Campaign linked “reported in”, and optionally adds the IPs and URLs the site lists for a Domain or ASN. Desktop only.

include_related_iocs.title: Also add related IoCs
include_related_iocs.description: For a selected Domain, add the IPs it resolved to and the URLs the site lists on it; for a selected ASN, add the associated IPs. Default: on; off means only the record itself and its reports.

max_related_iocs.title: Related IoC limit
max_related_iocs.description: Most related IoCs to add per selected Domain or ASN. An ASN page can list over a hundred addresses; the run says how many were left out. Default: 50 (maximum 200).

network.purpose: Read the lazarus.day record page for each selected indicator, including its related reports and IoCs.
